## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
ROTATION. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: cyclicals showing strength (XLE (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +15.92%) ABOVE TREND, XLI (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +7.83%) ABOVE TREND) while Tech (XLK (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -1.15%) BELOW TREND) and VXX (1W: +6.86% | 1M: -1.36%) RECOVERY, ↑ rising highlight mixed flows.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit dynamics mixed: HYG (1W: +0.14% | 1M: +0.57%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.89% | 1M: +2.00%) ABOVE TREND signal easing credit pressure while Credit Spread (Level: 0.7247 | 1W: -0.23% | 1M: -1.10%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND confirms tighter risk premia. Fear is uneven: VIX (Level: 28.98 | 1W: +0.66% | 1M: +8.30%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND supporting caution.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Dollar strength recovering: Dollar (Level: 27.12 | 1W: +1.12% | 1M: -0.55%) ↑ rising, RECOVERY. Bonds showing demand: TLT (1W: +1.77% | 1M: +3.82%) ABOVE TREND, → flat direction, signaling mixed equity/bond flows.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy and Industrials leading: XLE (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +15.92%) ABOVE TREND and XLI (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +7.83%) ABOVE TREND showing strength, while Technology lagging: XLK (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -1.15%) BELOW TREND. Style: rotation away from Growth into cyclicals and defensive pockets (XLU (1W: +3.83% | 1M: +6.44%) ABOVE TREND).

**5. US vs Global?**
US under short-term pressure: SPY (1W: -1.08% | 1M: +1.02%) CORRECTION, while Europe recovering: VGK (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +4.92%) CORRECTION and EM mixed: EEM (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +6.51%) CORRECTION; China remains weak: FXI (1W: -2.18% | 1M: -0.67%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Small caps and thematic speculation mixed: IWM (1W: -0.13% | 1M: +0.77%) CORRECTION shows shallow pullback, ARKK (1W: +1.93% | 1M: -8.82%) RECOVERY indicates selective rebounds, while crypto risk remains depressed: IBIT (1W: -0.57% | 1M: -25.00%) BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Energy commodities strong: BNO (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +14.20%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +12.98%) ABOVE TREND; industrial metals softening as CPER (1W: -3.42% | 1M: -0.48%) BELOW TREND shows cooling cyclical demand. Gold mixed on profit-taking: GLD (1W: -1.73% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy complex sturdy: XLE (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +15.92%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +14.20%) ABOVE TREND, while nat-gas weakness persists: UNG (1W: -4.22% | 1M: -4.61%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Energy/Industrials and duration — XLE (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +15.92%) ABOVE TREND and TLT (1W: +1.77% | 1M: +3.82%) ABOVE TREND — both timeframe-aligned. DIVERGENCE: multiple sector CORRECTIONS (XLB (1W: -1.47% | 1M: +9.63%) CORRECTION, EWJ (1W: -2.95% | 1M: +8.93%) CORRECTION, GLD (1W: -1.73% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION) signal short-term weak breadth within a rotational market.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals and energy exposure (XLE (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +15.92%) ABOVE TREND; XLI (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +7.83%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor bond-duration as defensive ballast (TLT (1W: +1.77% | 1M: +3.82%) ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to lagging Tech (XLK (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -1.15%) BELOW TREND) and China beta (FXI (1W: -2.18% | 1M: -0.67%) BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy (XLE (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +15.92%) ABOVE TREND) if oil momentum persists; Industrials (XLI (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +7.83%) ABOVE TREND) on industrial-strength prints. BEARISH: Technology (XLK (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -1.15%) BELOW TREND) and Materials if XLB (1W: -1.47% | 1M: +9.63%) fails to retake weekly strength.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Brent/WTI (BNO (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +14.20%) ABOVE TREND; USO (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +12.98%) ABOVE TREND) on supply-focus headlines. BEARISH: Copper/industrial metals (CPER (1W: -3.42% | 1M: -0.48%) BELOW TREND) and nat-gas (UNG (1W: -4.22% | 1M: -4.61%) BELOW TREND) on demand concerns.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX target watch ~30 (VXX (1W: +6.86% | 1M: -1.36%) RECOVERY, ↑ rising); HYG/LQD around 0.72 (Credit Spread Level: 0.7247 | 1W: -0.23% | 1M: -1.10%) ↓ falling; XLK/XLF ratio 2.6886 (Tech vs Financials Level: 2.6886 | 1W: -0.17% | 1M: -0.05%) → flat; SPY support at recent monthly pivot implied by SPY (1W: -1.08% | 1M: +1.02%) CORRECTION.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Energy and Industrials showing strength (XLE (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +15.92%) ABOVE TREND; XLI (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +7.83%) ABOVE TREND) while Tech (XLK (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -1.15%) BELOW TREND) shows weakness. Key risk is mixed sentiment—rising VXX (VXX (1W: +6.86% | 1M: -1.36%) RECOVERY, ↑ rising) and persistent divergence between weekly weakness and monthly strength across several sectors.
